summary: D.C.'s Attorney General has warned federal agents and the National Guard against interfering with the District's November election, while local media outlets have been covering the upcoming general election and highlighting D.C.'s population size relative to existing states. The coverage reflects ongoing civic engagement around voting and representation in the District. Without statehood, the District's National Guard answers to the President, not to the officials D.C. residents elect.
